patch_description: Replace the naive ring layout (which yields sum ≈ 0.96) with a hexagonal lattice arrangement of 26 circles — the near-optimal local structure for circle packing (density π/√12). Rows of 5,4,5,4,5,3 circles with horizontal spacing s and vertical spacing s·√3/2 use the square efficiently. Then replace the one-pass radius heuristic with an iterative relaxation solver: initialize each radius to its full distance to the nearest wall, then repeatedly rescale any overlapping pair proportionally and re-clip to the walls until convergence. This is a projection onto the feasible region (non-overlap + containment) and typically converges to radii near the equal-radius hexagonal optimum (r ≈ s/2), giving a sum of radii around 2.5–2.6, close to the AlphaEvolve target of 2.635.
